name: 2Player Tanks of War

userInputText: Are you ready for a realistic tank battle? Now, get ready to fight in a tank battle with your friend on 8 different maps. Fight with your friend, and the one with the most hits lost will lose. In the game, you can also buy a galaxy costume if you want. Blow up your friend the most and you’ll win the battle.
